title: Master mono
description: A master page (FUNC+LFO) after the internal mixer whose knob A sends the outputs STEREO, MONO or with left and right swapped. A template for core 4.1's master output (ev_render_master) and master pages (core_mpages): it names no firmware address, so its 1.54 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "The master output and the master pages").
